desc: Dwight finds his desk in a men's bathroom.
Dwight answers the phone at his desk in the bathroom.
Dwight talks on the phone at his desk in the bathroom while a man holding a candle walks past him.
Dwight practices karate kicks among a group of children in a martial arts class.
Dwight makes a traditional martial arts salute sitting among a group of children in karate uniforms.
Dwight kneels on the martial arts mat cleaning it.
Michael sitting with his legs crossed taps his finger against a black mug.
Michael crosses his fingers to form a cross shape near his eye.
Michael peers through the blinds while talking on the phone, pulling them apart with his hand.
Dwight strikes a training dummy with an open-palm hit to the head.
A man practices writing his sign in different handwriting styles on a sheet of paper.
Michael grabs Dwight by his neck and head from behind while he sits at his desk.
Dwight karate-chops Michael in the stomach in the office.
Michael falls to his knees, weeping his things off the desk.
Dwight in a yellow shirt pulls his shirt aside and shows his stomach.
Dwight, with a black bag under his arm, gets into a crowded elevator.
Dwight stretches on the mat, reaching for his foot.
Jim runs his finger along a training mitt while Pam looks at it.
Jim leans his face closer to the mitt, and Pam playfully taps him in the face with it.
Jim playfully pats Pam on top of the head with an open palm.
Jim lifts Pam holding a training mitt by the waist.
Jim in blue shirt looks stunned in front of a whiteboard.
A karate instructor gives a downward hand signal to start a fight between Dwight and Michael.
The karate instructor rushes in between two sparring men with his arms spread wide.
Michael, in the karate uniform, makes strange hopping movements with his feet.
Phyllis takes a photo with a camera while people watch from behind a barrier.
Dwight takes off his headgear and throws it at Michael.
Michael takes off his helmet and lunges at Dwight, hitting him with it.
Dwight stands up from his chair, makes a traditional martial arts salute and bows forward.
Dwight applies white-out with a small brush to business card.
Michael pins Dwight to the mat while an instructor in the background covers his mouth and laughs.
